notes: The SoundCloud logo button now starts a random station: when the random song ends, another random one plays (in your favorite tag, or from anywhere), never repeating an artist. Random picks now reach the whole tag, from songs with a handful of plays to big hits. Lyrics are smarter: the uploader's artist name is used, titles are cleaned up, wrong songs are no longer matched, and a busy lyrics service is retried automatically. The pinned mini player's corners are now properly rounded and see-through.
